title: Canon fact
description: A row in canon_facts.json. Written by verify.py. Read by prove.py and bake.py. The shape codifies the contract between the verifier and downstream consumers.

id.description: Stable claim identifier. Producers use known prefixes: 'verified:' (verify.py), 'first_app:' / 'total_app:' / 'flashback_count:' / 'cover_count:' / 'silhouette_count:' (extract_manga_facts.py), 'manual:' (hand-curated).

value.description: Scalar OR a structured value object (e.g. {chapter: N, type: 'full'} for first_app facts).

reveal_chapter.description: The manga chapter at which this fact became publicly known to readers. Used by the Spoiler Shield (spoiler.js): consumers filter facts where reveal_chapter > user's effective cutoff. Auto-populated by extract_reveal_chapter.py; manual overrides in docs/reveal_overrides.json. NULL or missing = fail-closed (item hidden by gates).
